annotations.title: Draft a request to one local for someone to confirm

description: Use this when someone wants one particular local to do a job, e.g. "get Marcus to do the gutters again", "ask Dana if she can clean Saturday", or after they pick a local from search_local_workers. Draft the request and get back a link THEY open to check it and send it. You cannot hire, book or pay anyone through this tool, and it writes nothing. The local hears about it only after GigNGo checks the request, and it also goes on the map so other locals nearby can offer. The local decides whether to take it. Pass the local's slug from search_local_workers or get_worker_profile. The text is run through the same screens a real post faces; if something is wrong you get the reason back. GigNGo runs no background checks; say so when you hand over the link.

category.description: Optional service slug or id. See list_service_categories.

description.description: The job in the homeowner's words, 12-1000 characters. Include when, if they said.

local.description: The local's slug or handle, from search_local_workers or get_worker_profile.
